$comment: Names other storefront platforms use, mapped to ours.
This is DATA, not code, and that distinction is the whole design. Our shipped
vocabulary carries no other company's brand; this table records what we are
willing to ANSWER TO when a theme written elsewhere arrives. It is the same
kind of artefact as a MIME-type table or a browser compatibility list.
`{slug}` is substituted from branding.slug at load time, so renaming the
platform renames the target without editing this file (§33.1).
Two ways to use it, both built:
platform theme:check <dir>  — report every foreign name with its replacement
platform theme:port  <dir>  — rewrite them, once, reviewably
and a runtime compatibility mode for themes that cannot be ported.
Adding an entry should feel like a decision: it is a name we agree to answer
to for as long as themes use it.
linkSchemes: URL schemes other platforms use for internal links inside theme SETTINGS.
A merchant picks 'the about page' in the editor and the theme stores <scheme>://pages/about.
Rendered as-is it reaches the browser as an unknown scheme and the link does nothing.
